standard-dialogue-without-ring-of-charos.npc: That's none of your business, human, and I'll never tell.

standard-dialogue-without-ring-of-charos.player: Oh, come on - I'm only curious.

standard-dialogue-without-ring-of-charos.npc: If it wasn't my duty to stand here and guard our agility course from the likes of you, I would be relieving you of your life right now.

standard-dialogue-without-ring-of-charos.player: So it's an agility course, then?

standard-dialogue-without-ring-of-charos.npc: No ... yes ... oh blast - you didn't hear me say anything, right?

standard-dialogue-without-ring-of-charos.player: No problem. Can I come in?

standard-dialogue-with-ring-of-charos.npc: It's an agility course designed for lycanthropes like ourselves, my friend.

standard-dialogue-with-ring-of-charos.player: Can I come in and use it?

standard-dialogue-with-ring-of-charos.npc: Certainly. The cavern contains two courses - on the west side is a Level 60 Agility Course, and and the east side is a Level 25 Skullball Course.
